missing_rule: Do not invent values for missing fields; keep status and reason.
time_rule: observed_at and published_at include UTC offset. Dates of valuations are separate from observation dates.
lineup_rule: players have name and starter boolean; confirmed starting XI has 11 distinct starters; predicted XI must remain PREDICTED
value_rule: squad market value, not company value or transfer fee
usage: Auxiliary evidence by default. Not prediction features until historical availability and model evaluation are established.
